coverage_notes:
WHAT IS SOLID (14 of 15 rows): The University of Miami's own football staff roster page, archived Aug 6, 2001 (preseason of the championship season), is the spine of this dataset. It enumerates, verbatim and in this order: Head Coach Larry Coker; ten "Assistant Coaches" (Randy Shannon, Rob Chudzinski, Vernon Hargreaves, Curtis Johnson, Art Kehoe, Greg Mark, Don Soldinger, Mark Stoops, Andrew Swasey, Dan Werner); Director of Football Operations Jeff Merk; and Graduate Assistant Coaches Frank Giufre and Rod Holder. Nine of the ten "assistant coaches" are on-field position coaches/coordinators (matching the NCAA nine-assistant limit); the tenth, Swasey, is strength and conditioning and is categorized as sc here. Every one of these people is independently corroborated by their own archived UM bio page carrying a 2001-dated role line, so no row rests on a single source.

QUOTE MECHANICS: On the roster page each person's name is a hyperlink and the role sits in adjacent plain text, so the verbatim quotes there are the role parentheticals and section headings ("(Defensive Coordinator)", "Graduate Assistant Coaches:", etc.) rather than name+role strings; the per-person notes say which hyperlink each quote abuts. Where a bio's "Coaching Experience" line contained a multi-space run after the year (e.g. "2001     University of Miami (director of football operations)"), I trimmed the quote to the whitespace-clean remainder so it survives text normalization. All quotes in this dataset were mechanically re-verified against the exact cited URLs before submission.

TIERS I COULD NOT RECOVER (real gaps, not omissions):
1. MEDICAL - no athletic trainers or team physicians recovered. UM's archived athletics site for 2001-02 has no football training-staff page; the surviving school-bio directory pages cover only department-wide administration (business, compliance, marketing, ticket sales, sports information), not team medical staff.
2. EQUIPMENT - no equipment manager or equipment staff recovered from any source.
3. ASSISTANT STRENGTH COACHES - only the head S&C coach (Swasey) is documented. His modern UM bio says he directs a strength staff of five, but no 2001 assistant strength names were found.
4. VIDEO / RECRUITING / ACADEMIC SUPPORT - Pete Garcia appears on UM's 2000 staff roster page as "Football Operations/Academic Advisor," but he is absent from the 2001 roster page and his 2001-dated bio capture returns a redirect, so I did not carry him forward. Not padding a 2001 row for him.
5. ANALYST and QC tiers are empty by design - those job categories did not exist in the 2001 NCAA staff structure; the equivalent bodies were the two graduate assistants, both of whom are captured above.

SOURCES THAT FAILED: The 2001 media guide and spring prospectus are indexed in the Wayback CDX (mifl-footbl-prospectus.pdf and the whole auto_pdf directory) but every capture is a 400-600 byte redirect stub with no retrievable content, so the media-guide route - normally the best source for support-staff tiers - yielded nothing. No coaches-roster page capture exists between Sept 2001 and the Jan 3, 2002 title game; the nearest in-season captures are Aug 6 and Sept 20, 2001, plus Rod Holder's bio captured Jan 9, 2002 (six days after the Rose Bowl), which is the single best confirmation that the GA tier was unchanged through the championship.

MID-SEASON CAVEAT: Mike Sullivan is the one shaky row and is flagged in his midseason_note. He has a genuine official UM bio page listing him as a 2001-arrival Graduate Assistant Coach, but UM's own preseason roster three weeks later names only Giufre and Holder as GAs. He is included because he is really sourced, but he probably should not be credited a ring; a consumer applying the "on staff at the championship game" rule strictly should drop him. The other 14 rows have no mid-season arrival/departure issues: Shannon, Stoops, Werner, Giufre and Holder all arrived for the 2001 season (before it began) and are documented on the preseason staff roster.
